newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb attack at French base on Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Bomb attack at French base on Corsica.

text.p: A bomb went off on Wednesday in an empty mess hall at the French Air Force's Solenzara air base in Corsica, causing slight damage but no casualties, police said.
News of the attack was released 15 hours after the blast occurred.

No one claimed responsibility for the bomb, whci came one day after the clandestine Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC-Canal Historique) said it had carried out nine attacks and one attempted attack against civilian targets on the island since October 25.
Solenzara was in the news two months ago when a French newspaper revealed there were land mines around the base, the only place in France where such measures existed.
The defence ministry said afterwards the mines would be removed to avoid accidents.
